verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched https://docs.metronome.com/openapi.json with HTTP 200, and the file contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The Postman collection page offers a second machine-consumable view of the API. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that describes the spec download, its coverage, and how it is versioned.
